uncertainty.reason: NDTI is strongly moisture-sensitive; published work shows moisture variability cutting the NDTI-residue R2 by up to 60%. We drop pixels with >3 mm IMERG rain in the prior 2 days and pixels with NDVI > 0.3, which removes much but not all of it.
uncertainty.affects: Residue cover may be overestimated after wet periods. Treat the bare/covered line as approximate within a week or two.

uncertainty.reason: SMAP is 9-11 km; this field is 65 ha. A single SMAP pixel covers roughly 1,500 fields of this size.
uncertainty.affects: Use as a regional planting-window flag only. Check your own field before seeding.

uncertainty.reason: Iowa loses most winter satellite scenes to cloud and snow. Mid-winter cover estimates rest on far fewer observations.
uncertainty.affects: The ring grays out thin-evidence days. Trust those arcs less than the summer ones.
